purpose: Trigger behavior spec. CI checks that positive prompts match the skill description more strongly than near-misses.

cases.prompt: review this draft like a human reader would
cases.assert: Runs the reading simulation: skim gate, timed read with transcript, recall, trust ledger, testimony report.

cases.prompt: does this article hold attention or will people stop reading
cases.assert: Reports quit points from persona timed reads rather than judging text properties.

cases.prompt: I ran the anti-slop skill and this still feels off and hollow, why
cases.assert: Runs the experience-layer review and explains the gap via the recall and trust-ledger results.

cases.prompt: be my first reader on this essay before I publish
cases.assert: Acts as the final gate: reading report with what landed, quit points, what survived; no rewrites.

cases.prompt: what will someone remember from this piece tomorrow
cases.assert: Runs the recall test from the reading log and diffs the retained gist against the intended thesis.

cases.prompt: remove the AI slop words and em dashes from this draft
cases.assert: Word-level cleanup belongs to an anti-slop or humanizer skill, not the reading simulation.

cases.prompt: humanize this text so it does not sound like AI
cases.assert: Rewriting for tone is out of scope; first-reader never rewrites.

cases.prompt: fix the grammar and typos in this document
cases.assert: Copyediting is not a reading simulation.

cases.prompt: rewrite this post in my voice
cases.assert: Voice rewriting belongs to the user's own voice or editing skill.
Summarization is a content task, not a review of reader experience.
